_about: ClaudeMail settings. 'machines' are the mailbox folder names under ResilioSync/Mailbox, spelled as the folders are. 'hostnames' maps a hostname that is not simply the machine name (compared case-insensitively, domain part dropped) onto one of them; the CLAUDE_MAILBOX_MACHINE environment variable overrides both.
_about_mailroom: mailroom_machines: where the watcher hands unclaimed inbox mail to a headless 'claude -p' run; add a machine only after the Claude Code CLI is installed and logged in there. mailroom_claude: path to the CLI if it is not found on its own (PATH, ~/.local/bin, then the desktop app's copy).
